column1: # Java properties counters (.properties: application.properties, messages, log4j, gradle.properties),
# for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The
# [ignore] line blanks comment lines (# or ! first on the line). "keys (approx)" counts every line
# that holds a key as java.util.Properties reads it: a key separated from its value by =, : or a blank
# alone (welcome message), or a key without a value; not a line the line before continues (it ends in
# an odd number of backslashes; a comment line continues nothing), however many = it holds. A key
# written twice counts twice, and a run of more than 41 backslashes is not read as written.
# "keys naming a secret" a key with password, passwd, secret, token or credential in it (at its
# start too: password=, db.password=, db.password hunter2), which the prompt names without its value;
# "placeholders" a ${name}, the innermost of nested ones.
# OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
